data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) encountered an API error (HTTP 400) when reviewing .SRCINFO, leading to an overall 'inconclusive' verdict. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Tool errors (like API timeouts or 400 errors) on non-executable metadata files (e.g., .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and deemed safe.
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to missing file analysis' and 'inconclusive due to tool failure' in the final verdict logic to prevent false inconclusives.
